name: weapon_arm_handoff
expr: deploy closes hand slots with a00_003; Stowed reopens with a00_001
evidence: own007420.tae anim 4 has kind=1 params [11,50] and [10,50] at frame 80; anim 5 has [11,51] and [10,51] at frame 100. Those select hanger_r/l rack clips a00_050/a00_051, but weapon arms have no rack dummies 80/81 (ac_states.csv bay_purge_l) and design 6009 has hanger_r/l=0, so no rack is spawned. The actual handweapon transition is 360 0x8289db50 (deploy), which calls 0x82853660 on hand slots 0xa/0xb; 0x82853660 -> 0x828535e0 -> 0x828525e8/0x82851ee8 only drives the hand weapon's own animation slot, with no reparent or hide. Hand binders hr1150/hl7020 ship a00_000/001/002/003. Rewrite `weapons::WeaponAnims::sync_weapon_arm_hand_weapons` plays a00_003 at deploy and a00_001 when the arm returns to Stowed; the synthetic `bay::WeaponArmStow`/`CoreBackRack` path is removed. name: stowed
expr: a00_030 f0 (phase 0) and a00_031/a00_032 f0 (phase 1) with flag-4 prong basis + 180 deg Z + dummy 87/88/85/86 local pos
evidence: Weapons attach to *_hg_f/*_hg_b with FLVER dummy 87/88/85/86 local translation ([+/-0.0012, -0.5188, -0.8182] in prong space, seating the peg at the weapon's top-middle rather than its grip) and acattachinfo flag 4 (fwd=[0,1,0], assembly_slots.csv) plus constant 180 deg roll around local Z (top rail down-forward, magazine/underside up-back, matching retail 360 Workshop captures) and zero animated pitch/roll offsets. Idle holds a00_030 f0 (phase 0, *_hg_b at ~51 deg down-back) or a00_031 f0 (right) / a00_032 f0 (left) (phase 1, *_hg_f at ~51 deg down-back), slerping over 15 frames into pure a00_011/a00_021 during bay shifts.
